name: Terabyte Shop
description: Brazilian online computer hardware store, founded in Curitiba. Sells processors, graphics cards, memory, SSDs, pre-assembled gaming PCs, peripherals, monitors, notebooks, smartphones and networking gear. Its llms.txt states it delivers across Brazil via Correios and other carriers.
description_es: Tienda online brasileña de hardware informático, fundada en Curitiba. Vende procesadores, placas de video, memoria, SSD, PC gamer armadas, periféricos, monitores, notebooks, smartphones y equipos de red. Su llms.txt indica que entrega en todo Brasil mediante Correios y otras transportadoras.

ships_to.notes: llms.txt states delivery across Brazil via Correios and other carriers. Free shipping above a threshold is stated for Curitiba and the surrounding region only.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: No pickup option mentioned in llms.txt.

search.notes: Homepage returned 403; automated access looks restricted (challenge).

shopping_notes: Prices in BRL. Automated access is restricted: the homepage returned 403 with a challenge to the probe, so the site is listed for people to follow. Store publishes an llms.txt and a delivery policy page at /suporte/entrega.

sources.supports: product range, delivery across Brazil, Curitiba free-shipping region, delivery policy link
